$comment: TASK-197 (audit D-6): every credential this repository and its deployments hold, with when it expires — never a value. Read by scripts/check-credential-expiry.mjs (weekly, .github/workflows/credential-expiry.yml): a date within leadDays, or past, fails the run; "unknown" warns until the owner records the date; "never" needs a note saying why. __tests__/credential-register.test.ts requires a row for every secret a workflow reads. Certificates are also checked from their own notAfter at boot and at readiness (platform/observability/certificate-expiry.ts). How to rotate each: docs/ROTATION_RUNBOOK.md. platform-foundation has no deployment of its own: an app keeps its own register (sync-excluded), with its deployment's credentials as well as its workflows'.

credentials.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
credentials.where: GitHub repository secret: the model registry check, the CI integration step and the security review
credentials.note: Created by the owner with this expiry.

credentials.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
credentials.where: GitHub repository secret: the CI integration step and the model check's voice list
credentials.note: No expiry: the only Google API key, key playform-dev in GCP project playform-dev, created without an expiry and shared with Playform's CI and deployments (owner, 2026-11-07). Rotate by hand (ROTATION_RUNBOOK).

credentials.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
credentials.where: GitHub repository secret (optional, not set): the model check's embedding-model lookup (TASK-204, N-50)
credentials.note: Not set today: no deployment uses EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai, so the model check skips the embedding models with a notice. If it is set, record the key's expiry here; a CI-only key, never an app's.

credentials.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
credentials.where: GitHub Environments staging and production: the migration parity workflow (none set in platform-foundation today, which has no deployment: the run skips)
credentials.note: A Supabase secret key (sb_secret_…) has no expiry: it is revoked or replaced in Supabase → Settings → API Keys (TASK-201; the legacy service_role JWT it replaces is retired by Supabase by the end of 2026).

credentials.name: SUPABASE_URL
credentials.where: GitHub Environments staging and production: the migration parity workflow
credentials.note: An address, not a credential: kept as a secret only so the parity run names no project.
